INFO.name: QUERY
INFO.value: SELECT source_id, r_med_geo, r_lo_geo, r_hi_geo, r_med_photogeo, r_lo_photogeo, r_hi_photogeo, flag FROM external.gaiaedr3_distance WHERE source_id = 2635476908753563008

PARAM.name: CITATION
PARAM.DESCRIPTION: How to cite and acknowledge Gaia:

PARAM.name: TERMS
PARAM.DESCRIPTION: Terms and conditions for use of Gaia data:

FIELD.name: source_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Unique source identifier. Note that this *cannot* be matched against the DR1 or DR2 source_ids.

FIELD.name: r_med_geo
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The median of the geometric distance posterior. The geometric distance estimate.

FIELD.name: r_lo_geo
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The 16th percentile of the geometric distance posterior. The lower 1-sigma-like bound on the confidence interval.

FIELD.name: r_hi_geo
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The 84th percentile of the geometric distance posterior. The upper 1-sigma-like bound on the confidence interval.

FIELD.name: r_med_photogeo
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The median of the photogeometric distance posterior. The photogeometric distance estimate.

FIELD.name: r_lo_photogeo
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The 16th percentile of the photogeometric distance posterior. The lower 1-sigma-like bound on the confidence interval.

FIELD.name: r_hi_photogeo
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The 84th percentile of the photogeometric distance posterior. The upper 1-sigma-like bound on the confidence interval.

FIELD.name: flag
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Additional information on the solution. Do not use for filtering (see table note in the reference URL).
